name: app-statement-paragraph-with-notification-photo
title: Dark manifesto paragraph with lime highlights beside a portrait and notification
whatItIs: A split slide: left, a black panel with a centred paragraph in large rounded type where key phrases are lime and some are dimmed grey; right, a rounded photo of a man leaning on a wall with a phone, a frosted notification card 'Your Pilo is 2 min away' and the logo.
whatItMeans: Confident and narrative; the alternating emphasis guides how the paragraph is read.
techniques: Vary text opacity and colour within one paragraph to create emphasis and rhythm.
Embed tiny pill badges inside the text as inline illustrations.
Overlay a frosted notification card on a photo to show the product moment.
Split the layout into a text side and a photo side with a rounded image.
bestFor: Brands with a bold tech voice

vocabulary.definition: Text where some words are bright and others dimmed.
A small pill placed within a line of text.
A frosted rectangle mimicking a phone alert.
A long statement of purpose set as a graphic.
